preconditions.description: Number of testcases T is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each testcase, the length N of array B is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= Bi <= 10**5 for B in Bs for Bi in B)
preconditions.description: Each element Bi in array B is between -1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, str) for output in outputs)
all(output == '-1' or (len(output.split()) == N and all(0 <= int(ai) <= 10**9 for ai in output.split())) for output, N in zip(outputs, Ns))
postconditions.description: Each output is either '-1' or a string of N space-separated integers between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(check_mex_constraints(B, output.split()) for B, output in zip(Bs, outputs))
postconditions.description: For each testcase, the output array A satisfies the mex constraints specified by B.
